Experience with Datadog or a comparable observability stack, and a point of view on what good looks like. Comfortable executing autonomously A pragmatic bias toward simple, durable systems, and toward shipping over gold-plating Bonus: experience in a regulated or healthcare (HIPAA / PHI) environment.
